top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks are a mature, independently reproduced measurement invention: magic-wavelength confinement controls decisive systematics while enabling many-atom interrogation and new tests of gravity, relativity, and fundamental quantities. Katori and Ye provide the most coherent proposed attribution, subject to the stated archival priority review.
recusal_note: No recusal-requiring connection to the proposed B033 laureates is apparent from the supplied profile. I disclose a shared WACQT institutional network with committee colleague Göran Johansson; it does not alter my assessment.
